+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+oauth2_scheme_user = OAuth2PasswordBearer(
+    tokenUrl="token", 
+    scopes={"user": "User access"}
+)
+oauth2_scheme_admin = OAuth2PasswordBearer(
+    tokenUrl="token", 
+    scopes={"admin": "Admin access"}
+)
+
+def get_current_user_admin(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme_admin)):
+    return {"user": "admin", "token": token}
+
+def get_current_user_user(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme_user)):
+    return {"user": "user", "token": token}
+
+@app.get("/user")
+async def read_user(user = Depends(get_current_user_user)):
+    return user
+
+@app.get("/admin")
+async def read_admin(user = Depends(get_current_user_admin)):
+    return user
+
+openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+security_schemes = openapi_schema.get("components", {}).get("securitySchemes", {})
+print(f"Security Schemes: {security_schemes}")
